root_text:
𝘿𝙊𝙃 𝙧𝙚𝙟𝙚𝙘𝙩𝙨 𝙡𝙤𝙘𝙠𝙙𝙤𝙬𝙣, 𝙗𝙤𝙧𝙙𝙚𝙧 𝙘𝙡𝙤𝙨𝙪𝙧𝙚 𝙤𝙫𝙚𝙧 𝙃𝙈𝙋𝙑 𝙤𝙪𝙩𝙗𝙧𝙚𝙖𝙠 𝙞𝙣 𝘾𝙝𝙞𝙣𝙖

In a press statement, DOH clarified on Wednesday, January 8 that HMPV is neither a "new disease" nor a "new virus."

Read: https://t.co/shnDyxfjvj https://t.co/FOgC5co6Sb
